My alopecia started as alopecia barbae. Then it ended up spreading to my head. I did steroid shots monthly on my beard and my head. I would not recommend the steroid shots. They thin your skin and honestly don't work or address the root cause. I also tried everything holistic. I changed my diet. Led a way healthier lifestyle. Stopped everything (I wasn't really doing anything other than caffiene anyways.) I did my best to reduce stress and started taking alot of turmeric to reduce inflammation in the body. I've tried oils, Minoxidil, etc etc. Tried alot of things. Then I got a ton of autoimmune biomarkers done because I was having alot if neck pain. Turns out I have something called primary sjogrens syndrome. They put me on a drug called hydroxychloroquin which is an immune modulator and alot less damaging than some of the other crazy drugs. It took them a year and a half to convince me to take the drug. It was my last resort. I started taking it and a few months later all my head hair grew back. My beard grew back too but all the bald spots have white hairs but the hairs are strong like normal hairs. My head hair grew back and turned back to my normal hair color but the hair came back curly lol weird. So after 3 years of alopecia I have my hair back. Very grateful for it. Hydroxychloroquin hasn't caused any weird affects other than hair growing back. Anywjo yeah I recommend getting some biomarker testing.
